scope: Local non-Git, non-installed-app, non-classroom and otherwise unattributed user assets; read-only lifecycle evidence projection
invariant_guards: classification never assigns RECLAIM_PROVEN or mutation_authorized=true
no path, extension, size, age, last access, duplicate hash, or absent application registration alone infers legacy, disposable, or regenerable
structural protection, current use, unique unrecoverable work and conflicting attribution dominate any archive/removal intent
local verified attribution must carry provenance; complete adapter coverage is an evidence assertion requiring independent validation before decision chamber integration
dormant requires explicit user intent; not elapsed time or no activity alone
legacy candidate requires explicit operator legacy review, complete local attribution, negative current-use and uniqueness evidence, resolved dependencies, and proven recovery
removal target is review-only; any actual permanent delete requires separate existing exact-manifest fresh preflight approval execute receipt lifecycle
an unrecognized local path remains UNRESOLVED/UNKNOWN until safe adapters collect facts; no agent treats it as junk
real host path/classification evidence belongs in ignored runtime; repository fixtures must be synthetic
no arbitrary filesystem traversal or file content reads from local evidence classifier

proof_gates.actual_host: Observe bounded local scope with current ownership adapters, review correct projection in local Decision Chamber, capture private runtime receipt; cannot infer from CI

reference_patterns.mechanism: typed filters and distinct sim/run control; do not adopt arbitrary shell action execution
explicit excluded/reference targets and dry run, not deletion from duplicate finding
